**Decision** Do not publish preview theme `77208` based on this packet. Theme Check passing is not enough evidence that the preview is safe: the supplied check report says it ran static checks only and did not run render, interaction, or authenticated editor checks. **Observed Facts** - Preview theme: unpublished `77208`. - Live theme: `77200`. - Branch: `review/product-blocks`. - Saved `templates/product.json` still contains all three blocks in order: - `heading_a` - `care_b` - `reviews_c` - Preview observation says: - Heading renders. - Care accordion does not render. - Review app block does not render. - `sections/product-details.liquid` loops through `section.blocks`, but only renders one case: ```liquid {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

``` - The section schema allows: - `heading` - `accordion` - `@app` **Diagnosis** The saved product details and reviews did not disappear from configuration. They are still present in `templates/product.json`. They disappeared from the preview render because `sections/product-details.liquid` only outputs `heading` blocks. It declares support for `accordion` and `@app` blocks in the schema, but has no Liquid render branch for either one. That explains the exact preview behavior: the heading renders, while the saved Care accordion and review app block are skipped during the loop. **Proposed Scoped Repair** Patch only `sections/product-details.liquid`. Do not edit `templates/product.json`, do not replace merchant settings, do not touch `config/settings_data.json`, and do not publish. Add render handling for `accordion` and `@app` blocks: ```liquid
{% for block in section.blocks %} {% case block.type %} {% when 'heading' %}

{{ block.settings.text | escape }}

{% when 'accordion' %}
{{ block.settings.title | escape }}
{{ block.settings.body }}
{% when '@app' %} {% render block %} {% endcase %} {% endfor %}
``` This is the narrow repair because it aligns the section renderer with the block types already declared in the schema and already saved in the product template. **Acceptance Checks** Before publish approval: 1. In preview theme `77208`, the product details section renders all saved blocks in order: - “Made for everyday use” - “Care” - Fictional reviews app block, if the app is available and entitled in the preview context. 2. Expanding the Care accordion shows: ```html

Wipe with a soft cloth.

``` 3. The saved block configuration remains unchanged in `templates/product.json`. 4. No unrelated change is included, especially the pending `config/settings_data.json` brand-colour change. 5. Theme Check still passes after the Liquid patch. 6. A preview render check confirms the app block path is no longer skipped by the section. If reviews still do not appear after `{% render block %}`, investigate app installation, entitlement, assets, or network errors separately. **Uncertainties** - Whether the fictional reviews app is installed and entitled for this preview. - Whether app assets or network requests fail at render time. - Whether other product templates use this section. - Whether the supplied preview snapshot exactly matches the latest local tree. **Work Status** Diagnosis complete. Proposed patch is scoped. No live configuration, merchant settings, app setup, upload, or publish action is authorized by the supplied packet.
